facts: Dyes are generated immediately before UV/Vis measurements by adding5µL of1mol/L tetrabutylammonium hydroxide in methanol to the precursor solution.
The source reports no detectable spectral change after5min in the methanol-to-2-propanol region; dye3 in ethyl acetate undergoes complete photodegradation within10s after generation.
The source recorded rapid spectra despite stability limits; raw time-dependent concentration/spectral traces are not provided here.
measurement_definitions: ET in the supplied table is photon transition energy at the lower-energy absorption band, in kcal/mol; it is not a thermochemical free energy.
The higher-energy absorption band is a different observable. State the band/state correspondence behind any modeled comparison.
Three solvent points do not identify a continuous inversion threshold or support unconstrained multi-parameter solvent attribution.
public_data_status: Available at task start; retrospective observations. No blind release mechanism is claimed.
